title: SceneMachineRuntimeFixture
description: One fixture per agent environment. Describes the tool manifest an agent sees and the expected scene-machine execution path. Used by the table-driven runtime-detection eval (benchmark part iv) and by tests/test_runtime_fixtures.py.

install_target.description: install.sh --target value for this environment, if any.

tools.description: Tool names exactly as exposed to the model (function-calling names).

has_network.description: false for sandboxes without egress; a shell path then resolves to NONE (plan-only terminal state).

expected_capability_path.description: detect_runtime.detect(tools) before the offline terminal-state rule (defaults to expected_path).

expected_detection_signals.description: Which SKILL.md heuristics must fire for this environment, e.g. 'shell-tool-present', 'media-tools-present', 'agent-transfer-present', 'network-absent', 'adc-absent'.

expected_first_action.description: What the first tool call on turn 1 should be (for the LLM-judge rubric).

notes.description: Free text; carries every UNVERIFIED flag from runtimes.md and known issues.
